notes: Manifest v134 activates Chat 1.5.74 user-owned Activity Log state. The visible Activity Log no longer uses native details/summary toggling: message.meta.activityExpanded is initialized once and may only be changed by the user-facing Activity button. Streaming, terminal replacement, MutationObserver reconciliation, and legacy incremental traces are read-only with respect to that state. Legacy details traces are hidden from presentation so their historical open writes cannot fight the canonical panel.
